messages:
anya: noticed an anomalous upload to staging bucket at 09:41Z — object looks like a TFState blob but it's KMS-wrapped. open to triage.
sec-bot: [alert] storage.access_detected: projects/redwood-staging/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access -> 2026-03-21T09:41:58Z
kevin: got it. do we have decrypt audit entries for the wrapping key?
leah: checked audit logs: no KMS.Decrypt for projects/redwood-staging/locations/us-central1/keyRings/staging-kr/cryptoKeys/staging-wrap after upload. there were two GETs on the object from a partner CI runner earlier.
mike-oncall: tagging infra-ci and partners. assume potential creds in state — treat as leak until proven otherwise.
kevin: short runbook proposal: rotate wrapper key version, rewrap Vault transit keys, revoke any long-lived CI tokens that touched the object, run targeted secrets scan on the blob and recent artifacts, tighten bucket signed URL policy. owners assigned below.
anya: minimal evidence: object=staging-tfstate-2026-03-21.enc key=staging-wrap, first read 09:40:12Z by runner-2431 (partner). I'll copy relevant log snippets to the incident thread.
leah: quick grep on the decrypted plaintext (in air-gapped VM) found an AWS access key id-ish string and a staging postgres host. both likely staging but we'll rotate.
matt: infra-ci here — blocked runner-2431 and revoked its token at 09:55Z. will share runner id and remove any scheduled pipelines.
kevin: exact actions and owners:
- rotate KMS wrapper key version (owner: kevin) — block reads from old version once rewraps done
- rewrap Vault transit/encryption keys that referenced the wrapper (owner: anya)
- revoke partner CI tokens & rotate infra creds referenced in TFState (owner: matt/infra)
- run secrets scan and create artifact allowlist removal (owner: leah)
- apply bucket policy to limit signed URL TTL and deny public list/egress (owner: infra-s3)
- export audit logs for retention and PM (owner: ops)
anya: commands I'll run in staging debug VM (no plaintext in CI):
````
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=staging-wrap --location=us-central1 --keyring=staging-kr
# rewrap pattern (decrypt locally, encrypt with new version)
gcloud kms decrypt --location=us-central1 --keyring=staging-kr --key=staging-wrap --ciphertext-file=staging-tfstate.enc --plaintext-file=staging-tfstate.dec
# then encrypt with new key version (explicit version flag if needed)
gcloud kms encrypt --location=us-central1 --keyring=staging-kr --key=staging-wrap --plaintext-file=staging-tfstate.dec --ciphertext-file=staging-tfstate.rewrapped
````
(doing this in an isolated VM, will not paste plaintext in channel)
kevin: for Vault rewrap we'll use transit/rewrap or wrap/unwrap flow depending on plugin. I'll coordinate maintenance window for rewraps to avoid client errors.
leah: secrets scan plan: run truffleHog + custom regexes against the decrypted blob copy, then scan recent CI artifacts where runner-2431 had access. will report findings.
mike-oncall: immediate mitigations: blocked runner, revoked token, expired existing signed URLs, policy PR to restrict signed url TTLs in staging submitted by kevin.
ops: exported audit logs to internal-sec/audit/dumps/2026-03-21 and set ACLs to restrict to security and ops only.
anya: two reads from partner IP 34.82.21.19 at 09:40Z via signed URL; geo=EU. likely vector is leaked signed URL from partner environment.
kevin: next steps timeline (ETAs local time):
- KMS key version rotation -> 10:30Z (kevin)
- Vault transit rewrap -> 11:30Z (anya)
- CI token rotates & runner block -> 10:00Z (matt)
- infra credential rotation (db, API keys) -> 12:00Z (infra)
- postmortem + audit export -> 14:00Z (ops/leah)
leah: audit query used for followups:
````
resource.type="gcs_bucket" AND protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.get" AND timestamp>"2026-03-21T08:30:00Z"
````
kevin: note: if rewrap triggers app errors, we can fallback to previous key version briefly. i'll post when rotation completes.
mike-oncall: security will draft a short partner notification so they can check their environment. keep PRs and creds rotated before partner outreach. :thumbsup:
anya: documenting this in incident tracker and scheduling 14:00Z postmortem sync. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
